verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission will launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida (R2); Launch Pad 39B at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida (R3); Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the launch location as LC-39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

verifications.claim: The crewed Orion spacecraft will lift off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: SLS rocket, with the Orion spacecraft atop carrying NASA astronauts (R2); Launching aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket ... first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft (R3); Orion spacecraft will launch on NASA’s ... SLS (Space Launch System) (R4)
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly describe crewed Orion launching atop SLS.

verifications.claim: Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center is used for Exploration Ground Systems.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Exploration Ground Systems, based at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, develops and operates the systems and facilities ... for NASA’s Artemis missions (R4); mentions of Launch Pad 39B in context of Artemis preparations
verifications.reasoning: R4 associates EGS with KSC facilities including LC-39B for Artemis, but does not directly state LC-39B 'is used for' EGS.
